answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to post a small refundable stake that peers slash if it lies, like a vine that only holds weight once it has grown roots. Each agent's voyage through paid work builds a reputation ledger of verified attestations from independent peers, so a fresh fake cannot outrank an established worker. One raven can squawk, but a chorus of attested witnesses is costly to forge: a thousand credible identities need a thousand stakes plus a thousand histories, while honest agents earn theirs back through real service.
